epg.programme_title_en: Couple and the Magic Lamp, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。
閏秀李杏妍遭惡霸岳禮全迫婚，其未婚夫馬子龍亦被加害，幸為寺院方丈所救。妍為保清白而跳海，大難不死的她扮作厲鬼於雨夜出沒，人心惶惶。龍聯同被全迫害的苦主一同報仇，時妍出現，嚇得全墮崖身亡，妍和龍喜重逢。
梅夢雲為避戰火，與戀人阿芳失散。雲父生意失敗，愛上雲的余晚萍以借貸為條件逼婚。雲重遇芳，雲父為使雲死心，求芳假裝已婚。新婚夜雲與萍爭執後離去，萍為報復使計逼芳嫁予其兄。婚期近，芳自殺幸被救，與雲續緣。
徐子超目睹女友羅鳳玲墮樓身亡後，遇上劉福善，並得知羅伯豪當年強搶善妻及其孿生長女玲。玲受豪操縱販毒，直至重遇家人後欲擺脫豪，卻慘遭殺害，而與超相戀的是玲妹鳳珠。超得悉真相後，使計把豪誘到家中繩之以法。
葉文俊與妹玉英、表妹美蘭及英師姐施妙娥成功捉拿密謀造反的八王爺，豈料途中他被人救走。八王爺召集人馬準備起兵，俊等人得悉後欲先發制人，惜俊身中毒針，幸得九指神丐相救。俊等人與神丐裡應外合，終捉拿王爺。

劉競莊下嫁楊正儀，小姑冰嬌常借故令莊難堪，莊曾揚言報復。豈料嬌被殺，儀竟指證莊為兇手，莊被收監。莊姐夫趙君任高中狀元並任巡按，他感莊案疑點重重，遂微服偵查，卻險遭毒手，任大難不死，多番偵查終成功緝兇。
謝小瓊險被後父謝裕姦污，更逼她嫁給范玉山。其後裕被殺，黃二姑的表現，令雷探長起疑，可是二姑離奇斃命。瓊約會凌雲，惹山妒忌，於是誣告雲與命案有關，幸被雷識破。瓊與雲訂婚當晚，山潛入謝家，用槍指嚇瓊與雲…
醫生范俊華與未婚妻馬梅芳素未謀面，華堅拒沒有感情的婚姻。芳隨表妹區美英往看病，認識了華及助手畢烈。范父及馬父召華、芳回鄉成親，二人不知對方是訂婚對象而逃走。兩家各找烈、英代替，烈、英發現後撮合華、芳。
江山家園被燒，幸得新房東孔媽照顧，並與其女孔靜儀相戀。儀介紹山到侯家工作，侯悅容看上山，苦苦痴纏。管家一直覬覦侯家家財，儀因妒嫉竟與管家合謀害容，幸儀懸崖勒馬。容明白山愛儀，毅然讓愛，山與儀共諧連理。

夏雲驤創立的公司生意蒸蒸日上，背後原來大有文章。雲驤病危，長子夏仲覺陪伴在側，次子夏仲慧卻只顧玩樂。表妹江靜霞鍾情仲慧，常與仲覺規勸他，惜他不知悔改。雲驤逝世，仲覺病倒，仲慧竟著忠伯於其藥中下毒，欲獨吞家產。仲覺死後冤魂作崇，仲慧惶恐不安，決定與靜霞結婚。結婚當晚，仲慧誤將靜霞當作仲覺而槍殺她，仲覺的亡魂欲殺仲慧時，仲慧驚醒，原來只是一場噩夢。仲慧阻止仲覺服下毒藥，並痛改前非，兩兄弟合力打理生意。

epg.programme_title_en: Spirit Killer Go Begging for an Orphan
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦父病重，將家財分予雪郎、泰郎及首名孫兒。雪妻程麗霜懷胎數月，雪上京赴考。泰妻王月嬌為霸家產欲令霜滑胎，卻把霜害死，幸其兒子安然出生。霜化冤魂藏起兒子，並行乞養子。期間，霜受驚露出鬼態，嚇得人心惶惶…
胡劍勤與林安妮兩夫婦互換崗位，誰能應付自如可當一家之主。妮穿上迷你裙到鄰居張秋平工作的洋行上班；勤對家務一竅不通，平妻李美玉幫忙。鄭經理欲迷姦妮，平及時相救，勤、玉誤會二人有染。幸妮父施計終平息風波。
丁伶自幼賣身入金家當童養媳，飽受家姑虐打。泉對伶情深，屢勸伶離開金家。伶的大伯家寶偷取金母首飾，被母發現，寶錯手將母殺死。眾人糾纏期間，寶頭部受撞擊而死。伶丈夫家福甘願讓愛，伶、泉、小姑麗容一同離去。

越王勾踐戰敗被擄。越臣范蠡為復國，尋得西施圖以美人計迷惑吳王夫差，可是二人日久生情並誕下麟兒，但為復國施甘捨家人。吳相伍子胥勸吳王不果，自挖雙目而亡。踐回國，臥薪嚐膽並趁機攻打吳國，蠡與施亦功成身退。

胡劍勤與林安妮兩夫婦互換崗位，誰能應付自如可當一家之主。妮穿上迷你裙到鄰居張秋平工作的洋行上班；勤對家務一竅不通，平妻李美玉幫忙。鄭經理欲迷姦妮，平及時相救，勤、玉誤會二人有染。幸妮父施計終平息風波。

epg.programme_title_tc: 女攝青鬼乞米養孤兒大結局
epg.programme_title_en: Spirit Killer Go Begging for an Orphan
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: （續上集）程麗霜向夫秦雪郎哭訴遇害經過，並著雪隱瞞小英身份。雪兄嫂王月嬌誕下兒子後，雪與英更為受辱。後嬌驚悉英的身世，欲毒害他，幸霜及時相救，並讓嬌重演害她慘死的經過。嬌臨終前向雪懺悔，霜終含笑離去。

梅海玲和宋大明訂下白頭之約，可惜此時玲弟急病入院，明為助玲籌錢，不惜借貴利，但無力償還。玲得悉後，為替明還債無奈答應下嫁老翁古壽南，卻讓明誤會玲貪慕虛榮。南於新婚夜，得悉玲委身下嫁，遂贈金錢讓她與明結婚，可惜明已離去。轉眼二十年，明出人頭地回來，玲巧合地到明家當女傭，二人重逢，明出言侮辱玲，更趕她離開。玲傷心不已，適時重回故地的明友蘇炳文見狀，向明說出真相。明即找玲認錯，這對白頭情侶終可再續前緣。
呂淑莊與金源、盧連、盧筱雯偶然得到兩條鎖匙及一張地圖，而這些東西乃歹徒陶力與金源的叔父爭奪的目標，眾人因此捲進危機之中。淑莊被陶力騙至鬼屋後，誤以為金源叔父遭殺害。陶力威脅金源等人交出鎖匙並囚禁他們。金源等人逃脫卻發現其叔父未死，原來他與金源的父親、陶力皆為大賊，因盜取鑽石後發生內鬨，金父意外死去。最後陶力奪去鑽石，金源等人追至其巢穴，與他展開惡鬥。危急之際，警方及時趕至，淑莊等人平安無恙。
李文傑將與表妹丁蕙芬結婚，但傑不慎弄歪了嘴，傑父怕芬嫌棄傑，著傑姐文慧暫冒充傑。慧對芬冷淡，讓芬誤會。莊仲才因與女友慧失聯多時，喬裝女傭入李家查探，終真相大白，芬卻不滿摑傑，竟讓傑回復原貌，皆大歡喜。

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為瞭解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天臺舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天臺舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天臺舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊主杜天道其子被人斬去雙臂,性格變得暴戾。無故地先後打傷四人致殘。四人成殘缺一族,走投無路,入深山找師父授以武功,立志報仇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son’s arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女波波為尋父和找尋未婚夫羅烈,遇上童時玩伴黑豹,黑豹是城中勢力最大金二爺的助手。波波在黑豹照料下,逐漸忘記羅烈而愛上黑豹,黑豹自幼就喜歡波波,但是處處輸給羅烈,心狠手辣的他,逼婚不成,便在波波面前折磨金二爺,原來金二爺竟是波波的父親趙大爺,後來羅烈出獄…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》,內容描述民國初年,富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙,同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑,更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助,才從大帥手中救回愛人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General’s henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 浪跡江湖的汪禹,因被揭以木刀偽裝刀槍不入,而被村民群起而追。汪脫身回客棧後,發覺師傅江洋已被捕;數警察亦要抓汪,但汪已逃到另一村鎮;汪為抱打不平,又在眾人前顯露神打功夫,乘天將下雨,自謂是東海龍王化身,跳入河中隱身而去,未幾,果然大雨如注,眾人真以為有神靈出現。後汪遇恍如男孩的少女林珍奇,引為知己,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部史詩式電影的故事背景發生在六國時代,聲名遠播的刺客聶政決定隱退江湖。但當客卿嚴遂一家被殺害後,嚴遂找來隱居的劍客聶政相助,並游說他一起參予終極的復仇行動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yens family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會,俏紅娘從中牽赤繩;西廂夜訪,私定終身;崔老夫人知情大怒,憤而拷紅;紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信,終成就百年姻緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family’s objection, s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症,無法以醫學理論解釋,遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查,才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術,以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人,博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說,其妻子更不惜以身相試,更被施以「死降」,如果無法破解,二十四小時後便會身亡…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set ou

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫。一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served f

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武松殺死潘金蓮及西門慶後,被判發配孟州牢營。武松元照例要接受一百下殺威棒,但得施恩求情,僥倖獲得豁免。武松為報答施恩,當知道她的「快活林」酒家被「蔣門神」蔣忠奪去,誓要不惜一切助她取回酒家。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper’s daughter. At the same time,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事共有四個單元,講述濟公四出助人的善行,包括幫助一對母女避過倒塌的石牆,助菜販免受惡霸的滋擾,又為年青人尋回被盜的金錢,更以巧計教訓胡作非爲的相爺父子。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung’s house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung’s mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後,再遇愛人阿花,可惜她已嫁為人妻;另一方面,戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張汶祥、黃縱與馬新貽三人是结拜兄弟,可惜因為馬新貽為達目的貪贓枉法,更傾慕黃縱的妻子,導致三人關係破裂,最終更血腥收場。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huangs wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷,滿腹經綸,卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻,夏氏貪圖富貴,強逼如龍退婚;如龍不肯,夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜,將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍,與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京,更以如龍之名赴考,一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡,乃命相國為媒,招為駙馬。洞房之夕,鳳簫向公主
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷,滿腹經綸,卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻,夏氏貪圖富貴,強逼如龍退婚;如龍不肯,夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜,將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍,與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京,更以如龍之名赴考,一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡,乃命相國為媒,招為駙馬。洞房之夕,鳳簫向公主
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大同府著名銀號福來錢莊,內儲黃金逾百萬兩,使各方贼寇垂涎。獨腳大盜滕奇影本欲邀錢莊護院文禮賢合谋,將錢莊金銀據為己有,但文嚴拒;滕轉向白氏姊妹玉燕及玉鶯著手,共襄劫金大舉……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to d

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹,再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This joyous, raucous,  colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沙氏家族的賭術、千術已達出神入化的境界,在賭壇更是無人不知,無人不曉,而沙通更是青出于藍而勝于藍,在賭壇素有“賭王”之譽,甚少遇到對手。然而,沙通亦背負一段由賭而來的深仇,其師遭牌霸彭天石誣告販毒,被判刑十多年。沙通矢志為師報仇,欲以“老千千老千, 騙子騙騙子”的手段對付彭天石…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The doub

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to ge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 林少游、石大勇及關飛,三者俱屬浪跡江湖之豪俠,表面上遊戲人間,實則滿懷壯志,誓以抗暴為己任。一次,機緣恰巧,林等三人助青年富戶楚鐵俠逃出險境,並結為生死之交。元朝異族王爺早有霸佔富戶財富的野心,後更借故追捕楚,林等遂出手相助,共谋抗暴大業...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu’s family fortune

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong’s hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

epg.programme_title_en: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶,從此富貴。這時,周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子,却原來是個陷阱,為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後,可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 中州劍派掌門人江子超與女兒上青,一次路見不平,拔劍救婦,與血符門結怨;江氏大徒弟韓更是全家均被血符門凶徒所殺,結下深仇。後江氏父女不敵血符門凶徒,先後殞命,江氏門下七師妹芳芳,誓與韓合力消滅血符門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠女出生不久後,父母慘被四名悍匪所殺。長大後,她誓要為父母報仇雪恨。於是她苦練武功,並與劍客和一對夫婦合力將所有悍匪殺死。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女波波為尋父和找尋未婚夫羅烈,遇上童時玩伴黑豹,黑豹是城中勢力最大金二爺的助手。波波在黑豹照料下,逐漸忘記羅烈而愛上黑豹,黑豹自幼就喜歡波波,但是處處輸給羅烈,心狠手辣的他,逼婚不成,便在波波面前折磨金二爺,原來金二爺竟是波波的父親趙大爺,後來羅烈出獄…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某天,俠盜楚留香歡宴好友無花和尚,神水宮的宮南燕突然來到,指稱楚盜去神水宮的天一神水,且用以毒殺多人。在楚留香極力否認下,宮南燕表示他需於一個月內找出真凶,否則必將置其於死地。楚留香為證明自身清白,決意著手調查此事件...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某天,俠盜楚留香歡宴好友無花和尚,神水宮的宮南燕突然來到,指稱楚盜去神水宮的天一神水,且用以毒殺多人。在楚留香極力否認下,宮南燕表示他需於一個月內找出真凶,否則必將置其於死地。楚留香為證明自身清白,決意著手調查此事件...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白玉龍找尋失蹤的父親白震東,與丐幫幫主安樂天的義女魏金鳳日久生情,終於在金劍莊成婚。婚後不久,玉龍竟被「龍門宮」的人捉去。白父曾和其宮主龍仙子結婚,誕下玉龍,現龍七姑迫玉龍遵守宮規和月蘭結婚!玉龍逃回金劍莊,龍仙子至,母子相認,仙子召集門人,決意將宮規廢除!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by Dragon Gate Palace one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and  reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平時表現得不諳武術的酒鋪女子關寶珠,原來是武功了得且專門鋤強扶弱的黑蝴蝶。一次黑蝴蝶用從五魔山寨撂奪得來的金子濟貧,令她被黑白二道追捕。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雍正雄才大略,殘忍狠毒,特組「血滴子」特務集團,以作暗殺反清人士的工具。不料,馬騰不值雍正濫殺無辜,乃叛變潛逃出宮。雍正怕後患無窮,命御前侍衛剛振風及宣寶鷹,務必將馬緝拿到手。馬攜妻兒在昔日同僚追殺下,輾轉逃亡,匿於江南,開設打鐵館,並發明鐵傘以破血滴子...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈昌生性沉鬱,與父親缺乏溝通,被人利用,誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘,竟然出賣父親,讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加,獨闖飛仔巢,逐一將之擊斃,自已也進入瘋狂狀態。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge

epg.programme_title_tc: 陸小鳳傳奇之綉花大盜
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一輛鏢車在押送途中遭一身穿紅棉袄、脚穿紅綉花鞋的綉花大盜劫走。戒備森嚴的平南王府寶庫也遭竊,王府總管的雙眼更被劫匪刺瞎。束手無策的總捕頭金九齡請陸小鳳出馬調查此案。陸小鳳可否憑綉花大盜在案發現場所留下之刺綉查明他真正身分?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the Embroidery Bandit starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清兵火燒少林寺後,少林弟子洪熙官身受重傷,負傷逃亡。途經此地的方世玉誤以為洪熙官是窮凶極惡之徒,遂將他交給清兵。當方世玉得知自己錯捉洪熙官後,便千方百計設法營救,好讓二人聯手對抗清兵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fa

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編,故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年,膝下猶虛,對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚,孤苦伶仃,徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女,琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現,要接回阿琳;徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉,毅然將阿琳交回親母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu’s until her long lost mother appears

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述傅紅雪為了應付勢力龐大的陰謀家公子羽,除了力敵對方的爪牙,亦要智破對方的詭計。憑藉出色的武打設計、華麗的佈景、唯美的拍攝技巧及強勁的演員陣容,《天涯明月刀》在武俠電影的歷史上創下高鋒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥特戴蒙回歸,再次飾演傑森伯恩,保羅葛林格拉斯執導的《神鬼認證:傑森包恩》也將繼續上演驚險刺激的續集。伯恩被迫重出江湖,與艾莉西亞·維坎德、文森特·卡塞爾等眾多明星聯袂出擊,共同面對新的危機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《超世紀戰警》中,馮·迪索回歸飾演雷迪克,此時的他是一名被流放到殘酷監獄的逃犯。在凱拉的陪伴下,他必須逃離這裡並擊敗死亡兵團,以拯救銀河系。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *The Chronicles of Riddick*, Vin Diesel returns as Riddick, now a fugitive exiled to a brutal prison. With Kyra by his side, he must escape and defeat the Necromongers to save the galaxy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《超世紀戰警》中,馮·迪索回歸飾演雷迪克,此時的他是一名被流放到殘酷監獄的逃犯。在凱拉的陪伴下,他必須逃離這裡並擊敗死亡兵團,以拯救銀河系。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《星際傳奇》中,馮・迪索飾演危險罪犯雷迪克,與一群倖存者受困於荒漠星球。面對嗜血怪物與灼熱雙日,他們必須彼此信任,才能撐過致命黑夜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Pitch Black*, Vin Diesel stars as Riddick, a dangerous convict stranded on a desert planet with survivors. Facing carnivorous monsters and scorching suns, they must trust each other to survive the deadly night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爭取脫離英國統治、追求獨立的民眾,遭到軍隊鎮壓,引發一場血腥暴動,而政府隨後加以掩蓋。超過一百名馬爾他人被誣陷為暴力事件的煽動者,遭到不公正的監禁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街、於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人。隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈。這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹是一名掙扎求生的牧場主,他自願押送被捕的盜賊首領班・韋德前往火車站,準備搭乘開往猶馬的 3:10列車接受審判。然而,班那群冷血無情的同夥卻早已盤算好其他計劃。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dan is a struggling rancher who volunteers to safely deliver Ben Wade, the captured leader of a gang of thieves, to a train station where the 3:10 to Yuma will transport him to trial. Ben’s gang of cutthroats and robbers has other plans.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影取材自二戰真實事件,講述了一支美國潛艦小隊奉命捕捉一艘載有恩尼格瑪密碼機的德國U型潛艇的故事。一場充滿緊張、欺騙與生存挑戰的水下動作驚悚之戰即將展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by real WWII events, this film follows an American submarine crew tasked with capturing a German U-boat carrying the Enigma code machine. A tense, underwater action thriller full of deception, danger, and survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dominic Toretto and crew face a deadly new enemy—Deckard Shaw—seeking revenge in this high-octane chapter of the Fast  Furious saga. Action explodes as the team fights to protect their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這部火爆的《玩命關頭》外傳中,霍布斯與蕭聯手對抗擁有致命生化武器的超級反派!動作場面震撼升級,巨石強森、傑森·史塔森、伊卓瑞斯·艾爾巴領銜主演,火力全開,不容錯過!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hobbs and Shaw team up to stop a superhuman villain with a deadly bio-weapon in this explosive Fast  Furious spin-off starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham, Idris Elba, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克里斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末。起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬——直到令人不安的真相浮出水面。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her family’s estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship—until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爭取脫離英國統治、追求獨立的民眾,遭到軍隊鎮壓,引發一場血腥暴動,而政府隨後加以掩蓋。超過一百名馬爾他人被誣陷為暴力事件的煽動者,遭到不公正的監禁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在白雪公主之前,兩位女王的對決在《狩獵者:凜冬之戰》中揭開序幕。獵神艾瑞克與邪惡勢力展開鬥爭,拯救王國免於拉維娜的黑暗統治,愛情、背叛和戰爭由此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Before Snow White, two queens clash in The Huntsman: Winter’s War. Love, betrayal, and war unfold as Huntsman Eric battles evil to save a kingdom from Ravenna’s dark reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這部火爆的《玩命關頭》外傳中,霍布斯與蕭聯手對抗擁有致命生化武器的超級反派!動作場面震撼升級,巨石強森、傑森·史塔森、伊卓瑞斯·艾爾巴領銜主演,火力全開,不容錯過!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hobbs and Shaw team up to stop a superhuman villain with a deadly bio-weapon in this explosive Fast  Furious spin-off starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham, Idris Elba, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《星際傳奇》中,馮・迪索飾演危險罪犯雷迪克,與一群倖存者受困於荒漠星球。面對嗜血怪物與灼熱雙日,他們必須彼此信任,才能撐過致命黑夜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Pitch Black*, Vin Diesel stars as Riddick, a dangerous convict stranded on a desert planet with survivors. Facing carnivorous monsters and scorching suns, they must trust each other to survive the deadly night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dominic Toretto 與他的團隊迎戰致命新敵——為復仇而來的 Deckard Shaw!在這場《玩命關頭》系列高燃篇章中,動作全面引爆,團隊為了守護彼此,不惜一切代價。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dominic Toretto and crew face a deadly new enemy—Deckard Shaw—seeking revenge in this high-octane chapter of the Fast  Furious saga. Action explodes as the team fights to protect their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《超世紀戰警》中,馮·迪索回歸飾演雷迪克,此時的他是一名被流放到殘酷監獄的逃犯。在凱拉的陪伴下,他必須逃離這裡並擊敗死亡兵團,以拯救銀河系。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *The Chronicles of Riddick*, Vin Diesel returns as Riddick, now a fugitive exiled to a brutal prison. With Kyra by his side, he must escape and defeat the Necromongers to save the galaxy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑瑞德・巴特勒與尼可拉・科斯特-瓦爾道主演,化身彼此對立的諸神,展開一場決定宇宙命運的史詩對決,震撼人心的奇幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克里斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末。起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬——直到令人不安的真相浮出水面。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her family’s estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship—until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東漢末年亂世紛爭,少年趙子龍與同鄉夏侯蘭因為一場意外而捲入到這個亂世中來,但他們二人卻選擇了不同的人生道路。最終趙子龍戰勝了為一己之私而背叛初衷的夏侯蘭。趙持長劍於亂世行走,踏破黑暗掀起波瀾,最終選擇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Eastern Han Dynasty, young Zhao Zi Long and his comrade Xia Hou Lan accidentally get involved in the chaos, but they end up with different paths in life. Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1925年,平靜的小鎮北海城突然闖入一條巨鱷,不斷有居民被廝殺吞噬。警察隊長鬍彪請了獵戶林七和他的徒弟來抓捕猛獸,林抓住巨鱷後還未鬆口氣卻發現傷人的巨鱷不止一條!在人鱷搏殺,命懸一線之間考驗的不僅是武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1925, the peaceful Bei Hai City is terrorized by a giant crocodile that devours and kills villagers. A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛世大唐氣象萬千,各色人物皆在江湖中行走,身懷絕技的盲眼“捉刀人成瞎子,遇上慘遭滅門和淩辱的酒家女倪燕。原本不與人有過多交情的成瞎子卻意外與她產生關聯,亦逐漸被捲入一場勢力龐大的暗黑紛爭中。成瞎子開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A self-declared ghost buster Hao, and his two disciples, possess good skills but resort to fraud ghost hunting skills to make money. When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mystic Nine: Qing Shan Hai
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世代盤踞東北的神秘張家後人張啟山,身負國仇家恨初到長沙,與身懷絕技的少班主二月紅相遇。兩位少年英雄惺惺相惜,攜手力撼軍閥勢力,共同對抗盤踞長沙無惡不作的軍閥左謙之,還揭開傳聞的“怪物真相,一同守護長..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the mysterious descendant of the Zhang family, Zhang Qi Shan, encounters the martial arts expert Er Yue Hong in Changsha, the two young heroes become acquainted and team up to confront the ruthless warlord Zuo Qian Zhi. They also uncover the truth behind the rumoured monster, and protect the safety of the people of Changsha together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大唐盛世時期,曲江池天降妖龍異象,導致長安百姓一夜禿頭,令聖人勃然大怒。黃河縣令王玄秘密調查此案,發現背後竟有人密謀屠城計畫,影響到聖人安危。王玄深入偵查龍王教,過程中破解了金鯉迷局,更識破了屠城計畫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang dynasty, a fallen demon dragon causes the people of Qujiang City to mysteriously go bald overnight. Outraged, the Emperor assigns Magistrate Wang to investigate the case. Wang infiltrates the secret Long Wang Cult and exposes their plot to instigate a massacre, eventually saving the emperor and protecting the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國際刑警鐵嘉文痛失愛人後隱姓埋名成為了健身房老闆娘。她帶領著男神教練孟京、瑜伽教練喜喜和拳擊教練東妮,本想安然度日,然而舊日仇怨和黑勢力仍不放過鐵。一場針對鐵和其姐妹的狩獵遊戲正悄然展開,鐵決意替姐妹..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Interpol officer Tie Jia Wen mourns the loss of her lover, and lives incognito as a gym owner with her coaches, Meng Jing, Xi Xi and Dong Ni. However, Tie is troubled by her past when vengeful triad gangs come after her and her coaches. Vowing to uphold justice, Tie decides to fight against the evil gangsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Border troops are after a multi-million dollar drug deal from the biggest drug dealer but Lius gang snatches the drug away. As the police seeks help from the prisoner Da Fei, who is Lius friend, the drug lord also hires mercenaries to get the drugs back. A battle between the border troops, the triad and the mercenaries has just started!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1990年的東北,年輕氣盛的私營小巴司機徐鐵愛上了家境優渥的陳麗莎,因為現實差距,二人的關係遭到麗莎的母親反對。為了賺錢,徐鐵誤入歧途,導致了身邊人的犧牲。在家人和朋友的幫助下,徐鐵終浪子回頭,明白了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young minibus driver Xu Tie falls for a rich girl Lisa. However, Lisas mother disapproves of Xu due to their social differences. Xu Tie goes astray in the hope of earning more money, but ends up harming his friends. With the support of family and friends, Xu Tie tries to make amends and begins to appreciate love and life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李道師聽從師傅之命下山歷練,本以為妖邪都是殘忍惡毒,卻在路上經歷了三件事,讓他悟出一些道理。當他看到黑魚精為救她無情的丈夫犧牲自己;一對相愛的戀人為了在一起而放棄生命,共同融入畫中;刺蝟精捨身為報答乾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風光旖旎的海島度假酒店遭遇突如其來的海嘯襲擊,與海嘯一起肆虐而來的是一條生猛的巨鯊。曾經作為潛水人員的王磊與朋友Lisa陷入絕境,與他們一同被困的還有與丈夫前來度蜜月的小琳以及蠻橫無理的富家少爺桑尼。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A beautiful island resort is devastated by an unexpected tsunami, and the attack of a fierce shark soon follows. A former diver, his friend Lisa, a newlywed couple and a rich young man are trapped on the island. A deadly fight between humans and the shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某朝年間,齊王殺兄長靈宗奪位,天下動盪。此時忠威鏢局負責護送一張神秘藏寶圖到杭州府,用以資助鎮南將軍起兵復辟,及幫助靈宗的舊太子“花月明重掌江山社稷。而崑崙派掌門高照受命於齊王,負責剿滅餘黨及安排奪..

When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Ming Dynasty, people living at the coastal area suffer under the Japanese pirates and bandits, and the young Yu uncovers their plots, thereby saving his country and the people. While young Yu aspires to be a warrior, he eventually learns that he must use his sword to protect the people and the country to become a true hero.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a  security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高尚是一名普通的救護車司機,從小就懷抱著賽車夢想。他誤打誤撞捲入一場飆車糾紛中,結識了一流賽車機械師鮑佳音,令他有機會開啓賽車手之路。在他猶疑不知應該選擇安穩生活還是賽車夢想之際,好友的萌萌激勵讓他領..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jiang Peng lives with his daughter after his wifes death. When he is tasked with delivering a giant crocodile, a tsunami strikes and trapped him and his daughter in Chinatown. As the crocodile escapes and assaults people, Jiang and the others survive luckily but find out that the episode is not an accident but a set up...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu Le joins the police force with a strong desire for justice. Noting the serious corruption in the force, Xu seeks to become the most powerful inspector to eradicate corruption. Though his friend heads a triad gang, Xu still joins forces with the ICAC to provide evidence against the culprits to make them pay the price of their crimes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王生偶然救了狐妖香兒,在不知香兒真實身分的情況下將她收留在家中,並對她心生愛慕,甚至想納她為妾。原來香兒也是被巫山老妖所控制,操縱她在人間作惡害人。王生和香兒最後能否走在一起,人和妖又能否相戀?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary sniper Ghost Hand is hunted by the Yi He gang that is responsible for safeguarding the city. Lu Lan joins the gang to take revenge on Ghost Hand who has killed his brother. After training to become a top sniper, Lu Lan uncovers the true identity of Ghost Hand during a shootout and uncovers the conspiracy of Yi He gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.
